title: Accurate Measures of Vaccination and Concerns of Vaccine Holdouts from Web Search Logs
reasoning: The paper constructs a hierarchical ontology of vaccine concerns that explicitly includes 'Religious concerns' as a subcategory. It then analyzes search interests related to these concerns, such as 'religious exemptions for COVID-19 vaccine requirements,' as a core part of understanding the motivations and behaviors of vaccine holdouts. This detailed analysis of faith-related concerns is central to the paper's findings.
